note: Grand Mesa NF campground at ~9,800 ft in the Mesa Lakes area on the north slope of the Mesa, between Jumbo and Sunset Lakes in mature spruce and aspen; most sites look over the lakes. Hilly loop, closely spaced sites. Mosquitoes are plentiful. Paved CO-65 access; CCC-built Mesa Lakes Ranger Station nearby. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed 26 sites, 30-amp electric (15 reservable sites), vault toilets, water, $26/$36, recreation.gov + first-come. Changed max length 50 -> 60 (FS spur figure; catalog tops at 45). Season: dropped closes 09-12 (that was the reservation season's end) for a late spring-early fall note; added booking.season 06-26..09-12, weekend 2-night minimum, pull_through false, senior/access discount.

Electric count: FS says 21 electric sites; the catalog types 16 as Standard Electric (15 at 30 amp, reservable).

Waterfront (stored lakeview) stands: FS and recreation.gov 'Most sites have views of the lakes'. On Esri imagery the east-side sites (2, 3, 5, 21-23) sit 20-40 m above the small lake's west shore with scattered trees; Jumbo Lake is ~150 m south. Nothing vetoes a view; no site is on an open apron at the water.
Operator: concessionaire-run (recreation.gov contact rrmofa.com). FS page: 'Site Closed' (season over). No GMUG alert names Jumbo or CO-65 at Mesa Lakes.

Pin 39.05310,-108.09086 sits on the east side of the small lake by CO-65, ~270 m E of the catalog site centroid 39.05369,-108.09388. Under the 500 m line but across the water from the sites; re-pin to the centroid if wanted.
